title: Matemágico · Serie de Fourier
description: docs/animas/matemagico/README.md § Serie de Fourier: the foe's own outline drawn back by a chain of circles (a DFT of its silhouette), a strike per circle. In the fight tester against three dogs, one player leading both, cast on a dog carrying nothing, three things and five, then on a castle pupil carrying four. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.turn = id => document.querySelector('#battle .turn-meta')?.textContent === 'TU TURNO' && document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"]')?.dataset.member === id; ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 900; }); s.allies.forEach(a => { a.hp = a.maxHp = 600; }); });

steps.caption: Cálculo with its new branch off Análisis Parálisis: Serie de Fourier

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 900; delete f.weakSpot; delete f.statuses; f.timed = {};  }); })

steps.caption: Serie de Fourier on a dog with nothing on its plate: one circle, the dial, draws a circle for its outline; one strike
Serie de Fourier on a dog with nothing on its plate: as it ends

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 900; delete f.weakSpot; delete f.statuses; f.timed = {}; f.timed = { quemado: { level: 2, left: 20, next: 5 }, empolvado: { level: 1, left: 20, next: 5 }, envenenado: { level: 1, left: 20, next: 5 } }; }); })

steps.caption: Three things on its plate (Quemado II, Empolvado, Envenenado): four circles, gold, orange, sand and green, draw a recognisable outline; four strikes, outermost first
Three things on its plate (Quemado II, Empolvado, Envenenado): as it ends

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 900; delete f.weakSpot; delete f.statuses; f.timed = {}; f.timed = { quemado: { level: 2, left: 20, next: 5 }, cristalizado: { level: 1, left: 20, next: 5 }, envenenado: { level: 1, left: 20, next: 5 }, mojado: { level: 1, left: 20, next: 5 } }; f.statuses = { sangrado: 3 }; }); })

steps.caption: Five things on its plate (Sangrado, Quemado II, Cristalizado, Envenenado, Mojado): six circles draw the dog itself; six strikes, each circle closing into a beam of its colour, the tone gaining a partial each time
Five things on its plate (Sangrado, Quemado II, Cristalizado, Envenenado, Mojado): as it ends
